game.name: NBA 2K12 (USA, Europe)
game.desc: NBA 2K12 is a basketball game available on Xbox 360. The player can relive legendary games from the great American basketball league and pit the teams of Michael Jordan, Larry Bird, Magic Johnson or Wilt Chamberlain against each other to find out who is the best team in history. The My Player and Association modes, both online and offline, are also included.
